children: Meta Platforms (META) is positioning its new Muse AI agent as another way to deepen engagement across its services while opening potential paths to future revenue growth.
Meta stock rose 5% after the news.

Muse is designed to help users carry out tasks based on longer-term objectives. The system can work with selected applications and services, while Meta uses a separate virtual machine to keep personal information isolated during those interactions.

The product enters an increasingly competitive AI assistant market that includes Google's Gemini and Anthropic's Claude. Analysts say Meta could benefit from its large user base and access to proprietary data as it works to build regular usage around Muse.

KeyBanc analyst Justin Patterson said user engagement will be an early measure of the product's progress, with monetization potentially developing later. Morgan Stanley analyst Brian Nowak also sees room for Meta to combine its applications and personalized data with AI capabilities.

The strategy comes as Meta continues spending heavily on artificial intelligence. Analysts expect those investments to support engagement, new products and longer-term monetization, although the spending could weigh on free cash flow before those benefits materialize.

title: Meta Stock Jumps 5% After New AI Agent Muse Takes Aim at Google
